citation.title: Real-time reflectometry measurement validation in H-mode regimes for plasma position control
citation.authors: J. Santos; L. Guimarais; M. Manso; ASDEX Upgrade Team

topic: Kalman-filter validation of real-time reflectometry separatrix estimates during ELMs on ASDEX Upgrade for position control.
own_question: Can measurements affected by ELM collapse and recovery be rejected automatically, using only reflectometry density profiles and line-average density, while also producing a confidence index for position feedback?
actual_method_and_evidence: Neural-network reconstruction of reflectometry density profiles was evaluated at 1 ms intervals. A separatrix density scaling (30% of line-average density) set the tracked layer. A Kalman predictor-corrector rejected measurements whose residual exceeded 1 cm. Confidence indices were computed over 10 ms windows. The text reports these results for one H-mode discharge (#20532) on the high-field side, compared against the magnetic separatrix and Dα. The authors describe the results as preliminary. Profile processing was reported at about 170 µs, but this is offline evaluation with no demonstrated closed loop. The study concerns electron density and plasma position, not ion or impurity temperature, and does not include a nowcasting baseline comparison.
input_target_timing_if_relevant: Inputs are reflectometry sweeps and line-average density. The target is a separatrix position estimate compared with magnetic reconstruction. Profiles are produced every 1 ms; real-time deployment is described as planned or underway.
validation_if_relevant: Single discharge; no train/test split; comparison against magnetic separatrix and Dα.
forbidden_inferences: Do not infer that it addresses CES temperature or ion/impurity nowcasting.
Do not infer demonstrated closed-loop control performance.
Do not generalize to all prior real-time diagnostics.
Do not treat the ITER accuracy requirement or results from one discharge as validated performance.
reason_to_include_or_exclude: Exclude by default. It is at most an optional example of Kalman-based measurement rejection with confidence tagging in real-time diagnostics, and its target, diagnostic and question differ from ours.
source_scope_note: All extracted page texts supplied; figure/equation visual validation remains separate
